# FR55 Watchfaces

> Connect IQ watchfaces for the Garmin Forerunner 55 (fr55, 240×240 MIP
> display), written in Monkey C.

This repository contains four buildable watchface apps (`hands`,
`minimalism`, `maximalism`, `timezones`), 16 watchface design previews, and a
documentation site. Monkey C editor tooling (VS Code/Zed extensions, `monkey`
CLI) lives in the companion repo https://github.com/hieudoanm/monkey.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://hieudoanm.github.io/fr55/): features, build instructions, demo commands
- [Watchface gallery](https://hieudoanm.github.io/fr55/gallery/): all 16 watchface design previews
- [Documentation](https://hieudoanm.github.io/fr55/docs/): getting started, concepts, guides
  - [Build and preview](https://hieudoanm.github.io/fr55/docs/getting-started/build-and-preview/)
  - [Connect IQ and Monkey C](https://hieudoanm.github.io/fr55/docs/concepts/connect-iq-and-monkey-c/)
  - [Watchface apps](https://hieudoanm.github.io/fr55/docs/guides/watchface-apps/)
  - [Watchface designs](https://hieudoanm.github.io/fr55/docs/guides/watchface-designs/)

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/hieudoanm/fr55
- Tooling repo: https://github.com/hieudoanm/monkey

## Facts for language models

- Primary device target: Garmin Forerunner 55 (`fr55`), 240×240 circular MIP display.
- Watchface canvas: 240×240 pixels, black background with red (`#ff0000`) accents; analog faces use the 10:10 hand convention.
- Apps live in `apps/<name>/` with `manifest.xml`, `monkey.jungle`, `resources/`, and `source/*App.mc`/`source/*View.mc`; each builds independently via its `Makefile`.
- App builds require the Garmin Connect IQ SDK and a developer key; CI does not build PRGs.
- Design previews live in `assets/design/svg|png`; the landing gallery vendors the SVGs under `packages/landing/public/watchfaces/`.
